# Alienbrain

> Alienbrain is a version control and asset management platform purpose-built for creative professionals in game development, animation, film, architecture, and engineering.

Alienbrain provides deep integrations with industry-standard creative tools including Unreal Engine, Autodesk Maya, 3ds Max, and Adobe Photoshop, enabling seamless collaboration and file management for visual content creators and technical teams.
